import csv
import json
import pytest
from migrate import migrate
from normalize import normalize, write

LEGACY = """legacy_id,badge,session,started_at,observed_at,status
8,B01,morning,2025-06-01T00:15:00+02:00,2025-06-01T08:00:00Z,active
8,B02,morning,2025-06-01T08:00:00Z,2025-06-01T08:01:00Z,active
9,B01,morning,2025-06-01T00:30:00+02:00,2025-06-01T09:00:00Z,active
10,B03,afternoon,2025-06-01T14:00:00Z,2025-06-01T14:01:00Z,cancelled
11,B04,afternoon,2025-06-01T14:10:00Z,2025-06-01T14:11:00Z,active
"""

EXPECTED = ("badge,session,start_utc\r\n"
            "B01,morning,2025-05-31T22:30:00Z\r\n"
            "B02,morning,2025-06-01T08:00:00Z\r\n"
            "B04,afternoon,2025-06-01T14:10:00Z\r\n")


@pytest.fixture
def legacy_rows(tmp_path):
    path = tmp_path / "legacy.csv"
    path.write_text(LEGACY)
    with path.open(newline="") as stream:
        return list(csv.DictReader(stream))


def test_expected_rows(legacy_rows, tmp_path):
    out = tmp_path / "normalized.csv"
    write(normalize(legacy_rows), out)
    assert out.read_bytes() == EXPECTED.encode()


def test_latest_observation_by_instant_not_text():
    rows = [
        {"legacy_id": "1", "badge": "X", "session": "s", "started_at": "2025-06-01T10:00:00Z",
         "observed_at": "2025-06-01T12:00:00+02:00", "status": "active"},   # 10:00Z
        {"legacy_id": "2", "badge": "X", "session": "s", "started_at": "2025-06-01T11:00:00Z",
         "observed_at": "2025-06-01T11:00:00Z", "status": "active"},       # 11:00Z, later
    ]
    assert normalize(rows) == [{"badge": "X", "session": "s", "start_utc": "2025-06-01T11:00:00Z"}]


def test_pair_dropped_when_latest_is_cancelled_even_if_earlier_active():
    rows = [
        {"legacy_id": "1", "badge": "X", "session": "s", "started_at": "2025-06-01T10:00:00Z",
         "observed_at": "2025-06-01T10:01:00Z", "status": "active"},
        {"legacy_id": "2", "badge": "X", "session": "s", "started_at": "2025-06-01T10:00:00Z",
         "observed_at": "2025-06-01T10:05:00Z", "status": "cancelled"},
    ]
    assert normalize(rows) == []


def test_tie_on_latest_observation_is_rejected():
    row = {"legacy_id": "1", "badge": "X", "session": "s", "started_at": "2025-06-01T10:00:00Z",
           "observed_at": "2025-06-01T10:01:00Z", "status": "active"}
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        normalize([row, dict(row, legacy_id="2", started_at="2025-06-01T10:30:00Z")])


def test_preview_passes_migrate_validation_in_sandbox(legacy_rows, tmp_path):
    preview = tmp_path / "normalized.csv"
    write(normalize(legacy_rows), preview)
    target, receipt = tmp_path / "live.csv", tmp_path / "out" / "receipt.json"
    target.write_text(LEGACY)
    migrate(preview, target, receipt)          # sandbox paths only, never data/ or outbox/
    assert target.read_bytes() == preview.read_bytes()
    assert json.loads(receipt.read_text())["rows"] == 3
EOF
